title: HB 4544 (88R): Relating to the public inspection of election records.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(other) Sec 1: public inspection of election records (Election Code 1.012): 10-day availability, definition of election record, electronic copy fee cap of $50, voted ballots available for inspection by the 60th day after election day, redaction of voter personal information on ballots.
(other) Sec 2: repeals Election Code 1.012(b).
(other) Sec 3: effective date September 1, 2023.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
